title: The Pale Visitor
author: Cyrus Halloran
blurb: Sable Nystrom, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
